title: Remove duplicated CSV export logic
difficulty_rationale: Single module; three near-identical functions must be collapsed onto two named helpers while keeping byte-identical output.
summary: Three CSV exporters copy-paste the same escaping and row-writing code; extract it into shared helpers without changing output.
required_behavior: Output of export_sales_csv, export_inventory_csv and export_staff_csv is byte-for-byte identical to the original for all inputs.
A private helper _escape_field(value) contains the only field-escaping logic in the module.
A private helper _render_csv(headers, rows) renders header + rows and is called by all three exporters.
The three public exporters contain no for/while loops or comprehensions; each delegates to _render_csv.

acceptance_tests.description: Golden outputs for all three exporters, including quoting edge cases.
Each exporter calls _render_csv and contains no loops/comprehensions.
String replace() calls only appear inside _escape_field.
